named.name: Gatebreaker's Horn
named.text: Hacked from the Siege Beast's skull. It still hums when the Rift Gate opens.

named.name: The Crown
named.text: The old King's crown, taken from the drowned palace. Whoever wears it hears his bargain, still being made.

named.name: The Mother's Cord
named.text: A loop of something that was alive in the Nest. It tightens when the wearer starts to drift.

named.name: The Goblin Lord's Cleaver
named.text: Notched, filthy, and much sharper than it looks. The Goblin Lord never cleaned it.

named.name: Heartwood Staff
named.text: Cut from the Tree King's heart. Small green shoots come out of it in spring.

named.name: The Bride's Veil
named.text: Black lace from the Vampire Queen's court. It smells of cold churches.

named.name: Scylla's Fang
named.text: One tooth from the Marches' hunger, long as a forearm and still wet.

named.name: Colossus Plate
named.text: A slab of the Stone Colossus, hammered into armor. It weighs less than it should.

named.name: The Dark General's Standard
named.text: A demon legion's banner, cut down and nailed to a shield. Its soldiers still salute it.

named.name: Orochi Scale
named.text: One scale from an eight-headed god. Fire and flood both slide off it.

named.name: The Village God's Eye
named.text: It looks out of the amulet, and it looks at you. The faceless people worshipped it for this.

named.name: The Overlord's Brand
named.text: The Pit's ruler fought with it for an age. It wants to go back.

named.name: Barrow-Warden's Lantern
named.text: A dead warden's lamp. The Barrows' dead mistake whoever carries it for one of their own.

named.name: Oathkeeper
named.text: Every knight who carried it swore something on it. It remembers each oath.

named.name: The Old Hunter's Longbow
named.text: The Beast Lands' last hunter left it at a crossroads with a note: 'Finish it.'

named.name: Wolfskin Jerkin
named.text: Still smells of the pack. Animals give way to whoever wears it.

named.name: Thornbriar Knife
named.text: A knife of black thorn from the Hollow Wood. It never quite stops growing.

named.name: The Drowned Bell
named.text: It rings under water. Hear it once and you never sleep through danger again.

named.name: Frostbitten Greaves
named.text: Rime grows on them even in summer. The Deep Cold left a little of itself inside.

named.name: The Last Smith's Hammer
named.text: The Forge Ruins' final smith built the constructs, then this to undo them.

named.name: A Mask with No Face
named.text: Smooth porcelain. Put it on, and the faceless people stop seeing you as a stranger.

named.name: The Heretic's Censer
named.text: The Apostate Court burned other gods' names in it. The smoke still curses.

named.name: Pilgrim's Staff
named.text: Worn smooth by a thousand walks to the six shrines.

named.name: Dragonbone Crossbow
named.text: Its string is a dragon's tendon. It throws bolts like a breath of flame.

named.name: Voidglass Ring
named.text: A ring of black glass from the Outer Dark. Look into it too long and it looks back.

named.name: The Twin Fangs
named.text: Two knives, always found together, never apart for long.

named.name: Alpha's Mantle
named.text: The pack leader's hide, still bristling. Other beasts give its wearer room.

named.name: Long Spear of the Hunt
named.text: Long enough to keep the thing you are hunting from reaching you. Mostly.

named.name: Witchwood Staff
named.text: Cut from a tree that was cut from a witch. It drinks.

named.name: Mossback Boots
named.text: Grown, not made. They leave no prints, only a little moss.

named.name: Tidecaller's Spear
named.text: It strikes like the tide comes in: once, and then again.

named.name: Eelskin Gloves
named.text: Slick, cold, and nothing gets a grip on the hands inside.

named.name: Gravedigger's Axe
named.text: For roots, for coffin lids, and for whatever is inside that will not lie down.

named.name: Shroud of the Unquiet
named.text: A burial hood. The dead take its wearer for kin; the Six are less sure.

named.name: Rimeheart Amulet
named.text: A heart of ice on a chain. It keeps its wearer's heart from going the same way.

named.name: Icebound Greataxe
named.text: Frozen in the ice for an age. It has not warmed, and neither do the things it hits.

named.name: Pit-Fighter's Knuckles
named.text: Iron and old blood. Someone won a great many fights in these, and then one too few.

named.name: Brimstone Plate
named.text: Forged in the Pit's own heat. It burns whatever burns it, and hates the rain.

named.name: Cogwork Gauntlets
named.text: They tick quietly. They have not stopped since the forge went cold.

named.name: The Unfinished Blade
named.text: The smith died before the last fold. The blade has been trying to finish itself ever since.

named.name: The Borrowed Face
named.text: A locket with a face inside that is never quite the same twice. People tell its wearer things.

named.name: Whisper Crossbow
named.text: It makes no sound. In the city, nobody would have heard it anyway.

named.name: Inquisitor's Signet
named.text: Its seal still opens doors in the Court, and some of the doors are glad to see it.

named.name: Penitent's Flail
named.text: Made for the back of the one who carries it. It works better on other people.

named.name: Six-Bell Lyre
named.text: Six bells for six strings. Played well, it sounds like the Shrine on a feast day.

named.name: Pilgrim's Sandals
named.text: Worn thin on the road to the Six. The road remembers them.

named.name: Scale of the Old Wyrm
named.text: One scale off a wyrm that died of age. It is the size of a door, and lighter.

named.name: Wyrmtooth Dagger
named.text: A tooth, sharpened. It remembers what it is for.

named.name: The Lantern That Remembers
named.text: In its light you can see the way you came, and the way you were always going to go.

named.name: Starless Blade
named.text: Black from hilt to point, with no shine at all. Looking at it too long is a mistake.

named.name: Raven-Quill Bow
named.text: Fletched with feathers from the birds that sit on barrow-stones. It never misses a face.

named.name: Marsh-Lord's Circlet
named.text: A crown of green copper that kept a drowned lord's head above the water, for a while.

named.name: Bone-Lattice Hauberk
named.text: Ribs, many of them, wired together. They used to belong to someone braver.

named.name: First Smith's Bracers
named.text: Heavy enough to stop a hammer. They were made to, more than once.

named.name: Lamplighter's Staff
named.text: The city's lamps were lit with it every dusk. Some of them still come on when it passes.

named.name: Sevenfold Buckler
named.text: Seven layers of hide, one blessed by each of the Six and one by something else.

named.name: Cinder Greaves
named.text: Black iron that has walked through fire and come out lighter.

named.name: Tidebreaker
named.text: It held back the sea once, for an afternoon. People still talk about it.

named.name: The Merry Knife
named.text: It laughs, very quietly, every time it is drawn. It is lucky, and it knows it.

named.name: Hearthstone Charm
named.text: A pebble from a hearth a long way from here. It stays warm, and so does whoever holds it.

named.name: Pilgrim's Last Coin
named.text: Set in a ring by someone who never spent it. The Six seem to know it on sight.

named.name: Gutter-King's Signet
named.text: The king of the city's gutters wore it. Thieves still bow to it, out of habit.

named.name: Stormcaller's Axe
named.text: It sings in the wind before the blow lands, and thunders after.

named.name: Lantern Shield
named.text: A shield with a lamp in its boss. In the dark between places, it is worth ten.

named.name: Heartwood Maul
named.text: The heart of a tree that would not fall, on a haft of iron that would not bend.

named.name: The Patient Spear
named.text: Its owners never struck first. They never needed to.

named.name: Eye of the Deep
named.text: A pale eye in silver, always open. It sees well, and it shows its wearer what it sees.

named.name: Frostbrand
named.text: A sword that froze in its sheath and never thawed. Wounds it makes do not bleed.

named.name: Ashen Hood
named.text: Gray as ash and quieter. Smoke does not sting the eyes beneath it.

named.name: Dragonhide Boots
named.text: Cut from the softest part of a wyrm's belly. They are very fast, and they remember fire.

named.name: Bloodhound Collar
named.text: A hunting dog's collar, worn smooth. Whoever wears it can smell a wound a mile off.

named.name: Antler Crown
named.text: Grown, not forged, from the head of something that ruled the wood. It does not want to come off.

named.name: Rootbound Plate
named.text: Living roots grown round a knight who stood too long in one place. Very strong. Very dry.

named.name: Drowned Man's Ring
named.text: Taken off a finger that had been under the water a long time. It keeps its wearer awake.

named.name: Sexton's Gloves
named.text: For handling the dead. They handle the living, too.

named.name: Glacier Plate
named.text: Ice that never melts, bound in iron. Blows go into it and do not come out.

named.name: Snow-Hare Boots
named.text: White fur over soft soles. They never break the crust of the snow.

named.name: Chain of the Pit
named.text: A length of black chain wrapped round the fist. It burns, and it frightens, and it takes a little of you every fight.

named.name: Ring of the Kept Promise
named.text: Its wearer always fights first and hardest, and everything in the battle knows exactly where they are.

named.name: Foreman's Helm
named.text: Dented a hundred times. It took every one so the head beneath did not have to.

named.name: Clockwork Crossbow
named.text: It winds itself between shots, and never quite stops ticking.

named.name: Veil of Many Faces
named.text: Under it, the face is whatever the onlooker expects. Sometimes the wearer forgets which one is theirs.

named.name: Confessor's Mace
named.text: Every heretic who met it confessed, eventually.

named.name: Judge's Mantle
named.text: Black and heavy. The Court's judges could not be swayed in it, by fear or by favor.

named.name: Sixfold Amulet
named.text: Six small saints round a silver disc, each turned to face away from the others.

named.name: Acolyte's Censer
named.text: Swung on a chain, it rings like a bell and smokes like a prayer.

named.name: Wyrmscale Hauberk
named.text: Each scale was shed, not taken. The wyrm that grew them would like them back.

named.name: Sky-Hunter's Bow
named.text: Strung for shooting things out of the sky. It has done it.

named.name: The Hollow Crown
named.text: A crown with nothing in it, not even metal: just the shape of one. It whispers what it used to rule.

named.name: Voidstep Sabatons
named.text: They step between moments. The body does not always keep up.

named.name: The Fool's Bell
named.text: A jester's bell that rings only when its bearer is about to fall, and never too late.

named.name: The Golden Wand
named.text: The Archmage's own, still warm, and still asking what it will be used for.

named.name: The Reaper's Sickle
named.text: It cuts what is ready to be cut, and seems to know which.

named.name: The Tower Stone
named.text: A cornerstone from the Colossus, which still remembers being a wall.

named.name: The Moonsilver Mirror
named.text: In it, the false light shows its true face.

named.name: The Sunbrand
named.text: A blade that holds a little noon in it, and does not like the dark.

named.name: The Thunderer's Bolt
named.text: A spear of frozen lightning, taken from a god who did not think it could be taken.

named.name: The Seventh Key
named.text: The key to the lowest gate. It is warm, and it should not be.

named.name: The Feather of Truth
named.text: Lighter than any heart. Whoever carries it finds lies weigh on them.

named.name: The Priestess's Veil
named.text: Whoever wears it hears what is not said.

named.name: The Thorn Crown
named.text: It grows a little every night, and it does not hurt the one it chose.

named.name: The Iron Sceptre
named.text: Its weight is the weight of every law ever made with it.

named.name: The Calamity Bell
named.text: It tolls the end of something every time it is rung.

named.name: The Twin Rings
named.text: Two rings fused into one. Neither will let the other go.

named.name: The Iron Wheel
named.text: A wheel of the Chariot, beaten into a shield. It still wants to roll forward.

named.name: The Lion's Hide
named.text: The pelt of a lion no blade could cut. Still none can.

named.name: The Hermit's Lantern
named.text: Its light shows only what is true, and only a little way ahead.

named.name: The Clockwork Shell
named.text: A piece of the snail's shell. It ticks, and sometimes it ticks backward.

named.name: The Feather Blade
named.text: Light as a feather, and every blow struck against its bearer is weighed and returned.

named.name: The Gallows Cord
named.text: Worn round the neck, as it was meant to be. It has never once tightened.

named.name: The Mixing Cups
named.text: Two cups on a chain. What is poured between them comes out cool.

named.name: The Devil's Fork
named.text: It takes a little more with every kill, and it never says what for.

named.name: The Fallen Star
named.text: A staff with a star caught in its head. It hums when anyone wishes nearby.

named.name: The Last Trumpet
named.text: The dead hear it and lie still, out of respect, or fear.

named.name: The World's Mantle
named.text: Woven of moss and stone and root. The ground holds up whoever wears it.

named.name: The Saint's Hand
named.text: A reliquary hand of silver and old bone. Laid on a stump, it takes, and a hand grows back.

named.name: Clockwork Leg
named.text: A leg of brass and spring from the Forge Ruins. It walks as well as the one it replaces, and never tires.

named.name: The Seer's Eye
named.text: A glass eye that sees. Whoever wears it sees again, though their gaze is never quite warm after.

named.name: Lethe Water
named.text: A stoppered flask from the river of forgetting. One swallow, and the worst thing is gone.

named.name: Surgeon's Kit
named.text: Steel, thread and a dead surgeon's notes. Enough for one patient, done properly.
